items.text: Booked the Lisbon offsite through the Holst travel portal and the confirmation email came back with the wrong dates. The portal's automated tool had shifted everything by a week, so I called the agency and they fixed it in ten minutes. Worth double-checking the paperwork before you approve anything in that portal.

items.text: Reviewed the Meadowbrook school trip booking tool for the PTA and it handled the consent forms well enough. The payment reminders were the only rough edge, since two parents got duplicates. I flagged it to the vendor and they promised a patch. Overall I'd recommend it for smaller year groups.

items.text: Quick note on the Harlow Summit venue app: the map view crashed twice on Thursday but the schedule tab worked fine. The organisers said they were rolling out a fix. If you're going, download the PDF schedule as a backup. Not a disaster, just plan around it.
